segments.name: Direct to Consumer
products: teddy bears and other stuffed animals

segments.name: Commercial
segments.description: Sells products wholesale to other businesses and licenses Build-A-Bear intellectual property, including entertainment properties, to third parties.
segments.evidence: Commercial – Transactions with other businesses, mainly comprised of wholesale product sales and licensing our intellectual property, including entertainment properties, for third-party use

segments.name: International franchising

segments.evidence: International franchising – Royalties as well as product and fixture sales from other international operations under franchise agreements.

revenueModel.text: Guests pay for personalized make-your-own plush experiences in stores and online, while wholesale, licensing and franchise partners pay for products, intellectual property and franchise rights.
revenueModel.evidence: we sell our products on a wholesale basis to other companies that then, in turn, execute our retail experience
